declarations.type: ∀ (n j : ℕ) {z : ℝ}, ¬n + j < n + (j + 1) → False

∀ {a c : ℝ},
  RankTransport.GoodCoefficient a c →
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → RankTransport.rank n j ≤ a → RankTransport.gap n j < c

∀ (n j : ℕ) {z : ℝ},
  RankTransport.P n ≤ z →
    j + 1 ≤ RankTransport.piReal z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) → RankTransport.P (n + j) < z

RankTransport.GaussianCurve →
  RankTransport.MarginInput RankTransport.ds RankTransport.bs RankTransport.us →
    RankTransport.MarginInput RankTransport.df RankTransport.bf RankTransport.uf →
      ∀ {β eg es ef : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          0 < eg →
            0 < es →
              0 < ef →
                ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                  ∀ (j : ℕ),
                    1 ≤ j →
                      j ≤ ⌊β * RankTransport.s n⌋₊ + 1 →
                        0 < RankTransport.gap n j ∧
                          RankTransport.gap n j <
                            Min.min (RankTransport.gaussian (RankTransport.rank n j) + eg)
                              (Min.min
                                (RankTransport.bs / RankTransport.ds +
                                    2 * RankTransport.us / RankTransport.ds * RankTransport.rank n j +
                                  Min.min es (1 / 2000000))
                                (RankTransport.bf / RankTransport.df +
                                    2 * RankTransport.uf / RankTransport.df * RankTransport.rank n j +
                                  Min.min ef (1 / 250)))
∀ (k : ℕ) {z : ℝ}, 0 ≤ z → (k < RankTransport.piReal z ↔ RankTransport.P k ≤ z)
∀ {n j : ℕ} {a : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → (RankTransport.rank n j ≤ a ↔ j ≤ ⌊a * RankTransport.s n⌋₊ + 1)

∀ (n j : ℕ) {z : ℝ},
  RankTransport.P n ≤ z →
    1 ≤ j → (j ≤ RankTransport.piReal z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) ↔ RankTransport.P (n + j) ≤ z)
∀ {n j : ℕ}, 1 ≤ j → 0 < RankTransport.gap n j
∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ), k < RankTransport.piStrict z ↔ RankTransport.P k < z

∀ {I : Finset ℕ} {a c : ℕ → ℝ},
  (∀ i ∈ I, RankTransport.GoodCoefficient (a i) (c i)) →
    ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → RankTransport.rank n j ≤ a i → RankTransport.gap n j < c i
∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℝ), 1 ≤ j → ¬(j ≤ RankTransport.piStrict z - (n + 1) ↔ n + j < RankTransport.piStrict z) → False

∀ {r : ℝ},
  0 ≤ r →
    RankTransport.bs / RankTransport.ds + 2 * RankTransport.us / RankTransport.ds * r + 1 / 2000000 <
      RankTransport.sparse r
∀ (k m : ℕ), k < m.primeCounting' ↔ RankTransport.p k < m

∀ (n : ℕ) {z : ℝ},
  RankTransport.P n < z →
    RankTransport.piStrict z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) =
      RankTransport.piReal z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) - RankTransport.endpointDefect z

∀ (a : ℝ),
  RankTransport.envelope a =
    Min.min (RankTransport.gaussian a) (Min.min (RankTransport.sparse a) (RankTransport.flat a))

∀ (k m : ℕ),
  (RankTransport.p k).primeCounting' = k →
    k < m.primeCounting' → m.primeCounting' ≤ (RankTransport.p k).primeCounting' → False
∀ (k m : ℕ), k + 1 ≤ m.primeCounting' → ¬k < m.primeCounting' → False

∀ (n : ℕ) {z : ℝ},
  RankTransport.piReal z = RankTransport.piStrict z + RankTransport.endpointDefect z →
    ¬RankTransport.piStrict z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) =
          RankTransport.piReal z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) - RankTransport.endpointDefect z →
      False

∀ {b m ρ β ε : ℝ},
  0 ≤ m →
    0 < ε →
      (∀ (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → RankTransport.GoodCoefficient a (b + m * a + ρ)) →
        ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          ∀ (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → RankTransport.rank n j ≤ β → RankTransport.gap n j < b + m * RankTransport.rank n j + ρ + ε
∀ (z : ℝ), 0 ≤ z → RankTransport.piReal z = RankTransport.piStrict z + RankTransport.endpointDefect z

∀ {D B U β e : ℝ},
  0 < D →
    0 ≤ B →
      0 < U →
        0 < e →
          RankTransport.MarginInput D B U →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                1 ≤ j →
                  RankTransport.rank n j ≤ β → RankTransport.gap n j < B / D + 2 * U / D * RankTransport.rank n j + e

∀ (r : ℝ),
  RankTransport.bf / RankTransport.df + 2 * RankTransport.uf / RankTransport.df * r + 1 / 250 < RankTransport.flat r

RankTransport.GaussianCurve →
  RankTransport.SparseCurve →
    RankTransport.FlatCurve →
      ∀ {β η : ℝ},
        0 ≤ β →
          0 < η →
            ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
              ∀ (j : ℕ),
                1 ≤ j →
                  j ≤ ⌊β * RankTransport.s n⌋₊ + 1 →
                    0 < RankTransport.gap n j ∧
                      RankTransport.gap n j <
                        Min.min (RankTransport.envelope (RankTransport.rank n j) + η)
                          (Min.min (RankTransport.gaussian β + η)
                            (Min.min (RankTransport.sparse β) (RankTransport.flat β)))

∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℝ),
  1 ≤ j → (j ≤ RankTransport.piStrict z - RankTransport.piReal (RankTransport.P n) ↔ RankTransport.P (n + j) < z)
∀ (n j : ℕ), RankTransport.rank n j = (↑j - 1) / RankTransport.s n
∀ (n j : ℕ) {z : ℝ}, 1 ≤ j → ¬(j ≤ RankTransport.piReal z - (n + 1) ↔ n + j < RankTransport.piReal z) → False
∀ {n j : ℕ}, 1 ≤ j → ¬n < n + j → False
∀ {n j : ℕ}, 1 ≤ j → 0 ≤ RankTransport.rank n j
